layout.$description: Window and container geometry (port-manifest §8.5, cross-checked against §5.2). These are desktop window constraints; Android reads them only as max content widths.

main-min-w.$description: Main window minimum width token. §5.2 records the shipped window as 980×640 with a 720×460 minimum — reconcile against tauri.conf.json when the desktop shell lands.

popup-w.$description: Quick-access popup width. §5.2 records the shipped logical size as 403×624; the extra 3px is window chrome.

content-max-width.$description: Reading measure cap for settings and detail panes.
